description: A supplied still becomes the first frame, and the prompt says what happens next in it. Otherwise the baseline: the same Lite-distill checkpoint, ten PiFlow steps at guidance 1.0, and a soundtrack generated alongside. The pipeline resizes and center-crops the image to width x height, so a portrait image needs width and height swapped (480x864) or its sides are cut off - the vendor's own tools instead size the clip to the image's aspect at the 480x864 area, which dw does not do yet.

width.reason: Kandinsky 6.0's pipeline refuses a width not divisible by 16 (the VAE's 8x spatial compression times the transformer's 2x patch) outright, so it is checked here before the pipeline load rather than after it

height.reason: Kandinsky 6.0's pipeline refuses a height not divisible by 16 (the VAE's 8x spatial compression times the transformer's 2x patch) outright, so it is checked here before the pipeline load rather than after it

num_frames.reason: Kandinsky 6.0's video VAE encodes 4 * n + 1 frames, and the pipeline floors an off-grid count rather than refusing it - a shorter clip than the one asked for - so it is refused here instead. 509 is the transformer's rotary table (128 latent frames); every checkpoint is trained at 121 frames, five seconds at 24 fps
